basic_info.description: Charming Single-Family Home with incredible upside potential. Located in one of the most sought-after pockets of the Richmond District, this home offers great versatility and can be used as either a two or three-bedroom home. Property is situated on an expansive 3,380 sq. ft. lot, and features direct access to an expansive backyard. The outdoor space could easily be transformed into a private oasis for family gatherings & entertaining. The kitchen and bathroom have been nicely updated. The large open kitchen features a separate breakfast area along with skylights, marble countertops, and access to the yard. Laundry hookups are located on the garage level along with parking for 1-2 cars.
